businesses.business: aviation aftermarket engines and aerospace products

offering_description.value: Owns and leases commercial aircraft engines and modules, and sells aftermarket CFM56 and V2500 engine parts and maintenance, repair and overhaul services. Customers are airlines, lessors and engine operators; it also develops proprietary replacement parts and repairs engines in its own shops.

primary_products.value: aftermarket aircraft engine parts; used and overhauled aircraft engines and modules; proprietary replacement engine components

primary_services.value: engine maintenance, repair and overhaul; engine and module leasing; engine trading and asset sales

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial airlines, aircraft lessors, engine operators and MRO providers

end_markets.value: commercial aviation; aircraft leasing; aircraft maintenance and repair

revenue_model.value: product sales: aftermarket engine parts and engine/module sales; rental or leasing: lease of aircraft engines and modules; service fees: engine maintenance, repair and overhaul work
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: develops and sells aftermarket engine parts to airlines and MRO shops; asset operator: owns and leases engine fleet to airlines; service provider: overhauls and repairs engines for airline customers
value_chain_position.category: component supplier; asset operator; service provider

geography_served.value: global: airlines and lessors worldwide, with operations in the US and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: aerospace products (parts, MRO) and aviation leasing of engines

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales and leasing to airlines, lessors and MRO providers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: aviation parts and repair require FAA and EASA approvals, export controls and trade rules apply
